title: The God of Abraham Praise
description: The God of Abraham Praise in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Daniel ben Judah, first published in 1400. The English translation is by Thomas Olivers. The tune, YIGDAL, is Traditional Hebrew. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: The God of Ab-r'ham praise, Who reigns en-throned a-bove; An-cient of e-ver-last-ing days, and God of Love; Je-ho-vah, great I AM! by_ earth_ and_ Heav'n con-fessed;_ I bow and bless the sa-cred_ Name for_-ev-er blessed.

lines: Ancient of everlasting days, and God of Love;
I bow and bless the sacred Name forever blessed.
From earth I rise and seek the joys at His right hand;
And Him my only Portion make, my Shield and Tow'r.
Shall guide me all my happy days, in all my ways.
He calls a worm His friend,
And He shall save me to the end, thro' Jesus' blood.
I shall, on eagle wings upborne, to Heav'n ascend.
And sing the wonders of His grace forevermore.
To Canaan's bounds I urge my way, at His command.
And thro' the howling wilderness my way pursue.
